messages:
maya (AE): FinCorp legal: POC ok but must be EU-only for normal ops. DR out-of-region only allowed on declared incident with audit. BYO-KMS (Azure KV). Need subproc list, KMS checklist, sample clause, and pricing delta by Friday.

oliver (Solutions Eng): Quick Q: DR must be region-level only? Any IP/CIDR constraints? Also confirm logs residency rule.

maya (AE): Region-level is fine. Logs must stay in EU unless DR is activated.

sara (Security PM): We can provide EU subprocessor roster and SOC2 artifacts. For Azure KV, customer must grant our service principal wrap/unwrap permissions; we'll provide a checklist and a short MOU for key rotation/emergency access.

tom (Runtime Eng): Two runtime options: 1) Tenant pin to EU dedicated pool (strong legal posture, reserved capacity), 2) Region-affinity with manual DR activation + audit hook (more flexible).

nate (Sales Eng): Customer wants a sample routing policy and a short contract clause they can show legal.

legal-bot: Uploaded eu_subproc_roster_2026.pdf and kms_checklist_azurekv.txt to /shared/fin_corp/docs. Draft DR clause saved as dr_clause_example.txt (sales+legal+sec).

oliver (Solutions Eng): Sample routing snippet for option 2 to include in appendix:
```
{"tenant":"FinCorp","primary":"eu-central-1","fallback":"us-east-1","fallback_mode":"manual","audit":"true"}
```
This requires manual activation and logs the event.

tom (Runtime Eng): Ballpark pricing: standby DR (EU-first hosted + on-demand DR) ~ +12-20% unit uplift; EU reserved/pinned ~ +30-45% depending on commit and SLA. Need QPS to firm up.

ops-oncall: EU pool headroom check: eu-central has ~30% spare today; POC pin possible short-term. No extra infra for Azure KV beyond service principal perms.

sara (Security PM): I'll draft the MOU and KMS checklist. Also preparing subproc attestation for FinCorp.

maya (AE): Thanks. I'll ask FinCorp for QPS, daily tokens, and RTO so we can give a tighter quote. Please aim to deliver the docs by Friday COB.
